module: Shows or hides the game interface: the web UI (CEF) and the imgui windows. Useful for screenshots, videos or tools. It stores the state in M.state (cefVisible, imguiVisible) and broadcasts the CEF visibility change.
usage:
ui_visibility.set(false)  -- hides everything
ui_visibility.setCef(true)  -- shows only the web UI again
notes: The initial state is cefVisible = true and imguiVisible = current state of Engine.imgui.
The CEF visibility change emits the UI event 'onCefVisibilityChanged' (guihooks) and the hook of the same name (extensions.hook), with a boolean, only if the value changes.
get() returns only the CEF state, not the imgui state.

getCef.desc: Returns whether the web UI (CEF) is visible.

setCef.desc: Shows or hides the web UI; emits 'onCefVisibilityChanged' (UI and extensions) only if the state changes.

setImgui.desc: Enables or disables imgui (Engine.imgui.setEnabled) if the state changes.

get.desc: Returns the general visibility state, which is that of the web UI (CEF).

set.desc: Shows or hides the web UI and imgui at the same time.

toggle.desc: Toggles the general visibility (according to get(), so the CEF state) and applies it to CEF and imgui.
